historical_prediction_manifest.warning: Exploratory diagnostics of unverified source labels versus untested decoys. Not evidence of NUDT5 inhibition, scaffold transfer, safety or therapeutic efficacy.

limitations: Previously inspected single-publication retrospective evidence; not fresh external or prospective validation. No models fitted, new experiments, selectivity classifier, significance tests, ratio confidence intervals or biological qualification.

R is reported mean catalytic IC50(NUDT14)/reported mean catalytic IC50(NUDT5), dimensionless; R>1 favors lower reported NUDT5 IC50 under these assay conditions, not an affinity constant, clinical selectivity or a validated biological class.

Source mean ± SD remains visible at each target. Raw paired replicates and covariance are unavailable; ratio uncertainty is not estimated. Table 1 reports two biological replicates; Methods triplicate sets and Figure 1 technical triplicates are not extra independent biological replicates.

NUDT5 and NUDT14 reaction times differ (20 versus 60 minutes). The shared TH5427 normalization wording has no clear NUDT14-specific exception. Comparability remains unresolved; this is not proof of assay failure.
Untested is not inactive. >50 uM is a strict bound, never an exact mean of 50. Double censoring permits any positive R and identifies no finite bound or direction.

Exact/neutral-parent/parent-tautomer training matches exclude only model diagnostics. All source rows, known controls and source roles remain visible. Related chemistry from one already-inspected publication is not an independent validation cohort.

All six frozen methods and both recorded scenarios are retained separately. Scores are uncalibrated label diagnostics, not IC50 predictions or selectivity probabilities. There is no outcome-chosen high-score threshold and no pooling of scenarios.

Source disagreements remain unresolved: Figure 1 versus CSV SD precision for 4/5, two trailing spaces, control/replication ambiguity, all-compounds-tested context and the reciprocal ratio orientation in the earlier structural report.

items.resolution: Unresolved reporting precision; compatible with rounding, not silently reconciled. Both representations preserved. No effect on paired ratios because NUDT14 untested.

Ledger trims one trailing space in each NUDT5 cell. Digits/status preserved; historical claim parsed cell values unchanged is not literally true for whitespace. Original files unchanged; raw strings retained here.

Combined NUDT5/NUDT14 Methods claims 500 nM TH5427 = 0% activity without a target-specific exception; Results describes NUDT5 selectivity over NUDT14. Target-specific control efficacy cannot be reconstructed. No assumption that NUDT14 was validly zeroed; no claim of demonstrated assay failure. Compound6 not-tested means no IC50 estimate in this CSV, not absence of control use.

locations: author CSV all 23 rows; 26 untested cells
items.resolution: Phrase occurs in SAR/Table1 context. Preserve explicit CSV missingness outside eight Table1 rows; do not expand all to all23 or import other endpoints.

locations: structural report section3 panel: nominal ratio >13.4
items.resolution: Existing number is reciprocal NUDT5/NUDT14 orientation. Here R=NUDT14/NUDT5 is strictly <0.0744. Source values agree; explicitly convert orientation, do not edit existing report or copy >13.4 as R.

Table1 defines IC50 SD over n=2 biological replicates. Methods says triplicate sets; Figure1 describes plotted technical-triplicate mean/SD representative of two biological repeats. Full nesting/IC50 aggregation unspecified; no n=6, covariance, paired raw replicates or ratio CI inferred. Compound4/5 uncertainty definition is not uniquely established by Table1.
